2. The facts, in short, are that Nazim Munshi was the Raiyat in the land of C.S. Khatian No.226 of mouza Dhanmoncli i.e. schedule-Ka land. 

 Nazim Munshi did not cultivate the said land. He gave bargas of the said land to several persons and their names were recorded in Khatian Nos.227 to 231 under the said Khatian No.226. 

 C.S. Khatian No.231 with an area of .60 acre was prepared in the name of Sumeru Pashi in C.S. Plot No.679 showing him as Kole jote Bargadar fixing rent as half of the crops.
